sentence: Generative AI repeats the pattern: technological opportunism converts into competitive advantage through three affordances
passage: [Li et al. (2026), p. 1] "find that three GenAI affordances--organizational memory, collaborative, and creational affordances--mediate the relationship between TO and competitive advantages."

gemini.note: The passage confirms that three affordances mediate technological opportunism and competitive advantage, but does not state that this repeats an existing pattern.
